title: その天才、俺が買う
reward: 鍛冶師の仲間と天魔剣の共鳴

scenes.name: 人の値札
scenes.purpose: ゲームの報酬を人間として捉え直す

panels.art: Yun and grizzled male vault keeper in brown robes face iron cell, smith behind bars. Yun points to wrist chain, sheathed sword.
panels.speaker: 番人

panels.art: Close Yun places a cloth bag of silver on table with TWO hands; sword remains sheathed. Smith in distant background frowns.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Keeper hands Yun a paper ownership contract, no legible writing except marks. Yun looks at paper with discomfort, not greed.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun tears ownership contract in TWO, intact halves in hands. So Rin sees through bars, startled. No shackle breaking yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 代金は払う。契約は捨てる。

scenes.name: 自由な手
scenes.purpose: 強さを壊す力から守る力へ使う

panels.art: Yun opens iron cell using keeper key. Kneels before smith, keeps her face visible and sword sheathed. His TWO right fingers touch ONE connecting link between her wrist shackles.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 動かないで。鎖だけ、切る。

panels.art: Close-up chain link snaps between fingers, wrist shackles now fall OPEN harmlessly, no cuts no blood. So Rin pulls her hands free.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: So Rin rubs her freed wrist; cuffs and chain lie on floor behind and NEVER return. Yun offers blue-black star metal with left open palm, sword sheathed.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 行き先は、自分で決めて。

panels.art: So Rin stands, chooses to take ONE star metal stone and looks at Yun's sheathed sword with renewed purpose.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: なら、あんたの剣を直す。

scenes.name: 剣と懸賞
scenes.purpose: 救った相手の仕事で報酬を得て大会へつなぐ

panels.art: Hours later at warm forge. Yun robes now clean off-white same charcoal lapel dark red sash, faint cheek bruise. Smith free wrists, sleeves rolled safely, strikes a blue-black shard on anvil with ONE hammer. Yun waits rather than interrupting.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: 強いだけじゃ、剣は応えない。

panels.art: Smith returns upgraded heavenly demon sword by offering its hilt safely, same black straight blade round gold guard red tassel, thin CYAN edge. Yun takes hilt RIGHT hand.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Yun holds sword lowered safely. At forge wall a newly delivered parchment shows his face and a gold prize seal but NO extra text; smith looks alarmed.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: 大会の懸賞に、あんたの顔。

panels.art: Close Yun reads parchment, thoughtful eyes, smith at edge. Do not show arena yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
